description: Guard external contracts before changing them. Use BEFORE modifying anything consumed outside the current codebase or by clients you do not control: public/exported APIs, REST/GraphQL endpoints and their request/response shapes, published package entry points, database schemas read by other services, event/message payloads, webhooks, or generated client types. Also use when reviewing a diff that touches such surfaces. Prevents silently shipping breaking changes to external consumers.
